nodes.label: BitNet Quantizer
nodes.title: BitNet 1.58-bit Quantization
nodes.description: Applies 1.58-bit quantization using the BitNet method, converting linear layers to BitLinear for efficient inference. Requires 'accelerate'.

nodes.label: BitsAndBytes 4-bit Quantizer
nodes.title: BitsAndBytes 4-bit Quantization
nodes.description: Implements 4-bit quantization for model weights using the bitsandbytes library, reducing memory footprint. Requires 'accelerate' and 'bitsandbytes'.

nodes.label: BitsAndBytes 8-bit Quantizer
nodes.title: BitsAndBytes 8-bit Quantization
nodes.description: Implements 8-bit quantization for model weights using the bitsandbytes library, balancing precision and memory. Requires 'accelerate' and 'bitsandbytes'.

nodes.label: Fine-Grained FP8 Quantizer
nodes.title: Fine-Grained FP8 Quantization
nodes.description: Provides FP8 quantization, supporting standard and MoE models, leveraging GPU/XPU capabilities for performance. Requires 'accelerate' and compatible GPU/XPU.

nodes.label: FP-Quant Quantizer
nodes.title: FP-Quant Method
nodes.description: Handles FP-Quant method for loading pre-quantized models or on-the-fly quantization, optimized for specific hardware. Requires GPU/XPU, 'qutlass' (for real quant), and 'fp_quant'.

nodes.label: Metal Quantizer
nodes.title: Metal Affine Quantization (MPS)
nodes.description: Enables Metal affine quantization for Apple Silicon (MPS) devices, utilizing low-bit uint32 tensors with fused dequantization. Requires MPS device and 'kernels'.

nodes.label: MXFP4 Quantizer
nodes.title: MXFP4 Quantization
nodes.description: Performs FP4 quantization using FBGEMM kernels, suitable for various hardware with specific compute capabilities. Requires 'torch', 'accelerate', 'triton', 'kernels', and compatible GPU/XPU.

nodes.label: Quark Quantizer
nodes.title: Quark Quantization
nodes.description: Integrates Quark quantization for efficient model deployment, primarily for pre-quantized models. Requires the 'quark' library.

nodes.label: SINQ Quantizer
nodes.title: SINQ Quantization
nodes.description: Applies SINQ quantization, supporting weight-only or activation-aware methods, converting linear layers to SINQLinear. Requires 'sinq' and CUDA.

nodes.label: TorchAo Quantizer
nodes.title: TorchAo Quantization
nodes.description: Utilizes the torchao library for various quantization types, including 4-bit and 8-bit, with support for training. Requires 'torchao'.

nodes.description: Utilizes the torchao library for various quantization types, including 4-bit and 8-bit, with support for training. Requires 'torchao'.

groups.label: Quantization Methods
groups.title: Quantization Implementations
groups.description: Provides various quantization algorithms and their specific configurations.

groups.label: Model Interface

external_integrations.title: External Integrations Module
external_integrations.description: This module provides core components for integrating Hugging Face models and training workflows with external tools and libraries, including hyperparameter search platforms, experiment tracking systems, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods.

nodes.label: Wandb Backend
nodes.title: Wandb Backend Integration
nodes.description: Provides an interface for integrating with the Weights & Biases platform, enabling hyperparameter search, experiment tracking, and logging of training runs. It allows users to leverage Wandb's optimization capabilities directly within the training workflow.

nodes.label: DVCLive Callback
nodes.title: DVCLive Experiment Logging
nodes.description: A callback mechanism for the Hugging Face Trainer that facilitates logging of training metrics, parameters, and model checkpoints to DVCLive. It ensures experiment reproducibility and versioning by integrating with DVC's data and model management features.

nodes.label: PEFT Adapter Mixin
nodes.title: PEFT Adapter Management
nodes.description: Enables dynamic loading, management, and application of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) adapters to models. This mixin supports various PEFT methods like LoRA, allowing for efficient model customization and deployment without modifying the base model's full weights.

nodes.label: Wandb Service
nodes.title: Weights & Biases Platform
nodes.description: An external machine learning platform used for experiment tracking, visualization, and hyperparameter optimization. It provides tools to monitor training, compare runs, and manage datasets and models effectively.

nodes.label: DVCLive Service
nodes.title: DVCLive Experiment Tracking
nodes.description: An open-source library for experiment tracking and versioning, integrated with DVC. It helps in logging metrics, parameters, and artifacts, ensuring reproducibility and traceability of machine learning experiments.

nodes.label: PEFT Library
nodes.title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Library
nodes.description: An external library providing methods for efficiently adapting large pre-trained models to new tasks with minimal trainable parameters. It includes techniques like LoRA, IA³, and others, significantly reducing computational and memory costs during fine-tuning.

nodes.label: Accelerate Library
nodes.title: Accelerate Distributed Training
nodes.description: An external library from Hugging Face designed to simplify distributed training and mixed-precision training across various hardware setups. It handles device placement and model dispatch, optimizing performance for large models.

nodes.label: Hugging Face Trainer
nodes.title: Hugging Face Trainer
nodes.description: The core training loop utility in Hugging Face Transformers, responsible for orchestrating model training, evaluation, and prediction. It provides a high-level API for common ML tasks and integrates with callbacks for extended functionality.

nodes.label: Modeling Utilities
nodes.title: Model Loading and Conversion Utilities
nodes.description: Internal utilities responsible for loading model weights, handling checkpoint files, and managing state dictionary conversions. These functions are crucial for ensuring compatibility and correct initialization of models and their components.

groups.label: Integration Components
groups.title: Core Integration Components
groups.description: These are the primary components within the external_integrations module that facilitate interaction with external systems and libraries.

groups.label: External Systems
groups.title: Third-Party Services and Libraries

cli_tools.title: CLI Serving Tools
cli_tools.description: This module provides command-line interface tools for serving Hugging Face Transformer models via an API, including features like continuous batching, quantization, and dynamic model management.

nodes.label: CLI Server Entry Point
nodes.title: Serve CLI
nodes.description: The main command-line interface for starting the model serving API. It parses arguments and orchestrates the server setup and lifecycle.

nodes.label: Manage Model Loading
nodes.title: Model Manager
nodes.description: Handles the dynamic loading, unloading, and management of Transformer models based on requests and configuration, including device and quantization settings.

nodes.label: Configure Generation
nodes.title: Generation State
nodes.description: Manages inference generation parameters such as continuous batching, `torch.compile` usage, and other performance-related settings for model inference.

nodes.label: Handle Chat Completions
nodes.title: Chat Completion Handler
nodes.description: Processes API requests for chat-based text generation, interacting with the model manager and generation state to produce responses.

nodes.label: Handle Text Completions
nodes.title: Text Completion Handler
nodes.description: Processes API requests for general text completion, interacting with the model manager and generation state to fulfill requests.

nodes.label: Handle Model Responses
nodes.title: Response Handler
nodes.description: Manages general model response generation, providing a flexible interface for various model outputs beyond specific chat or text completions.

nodes.label: Handle Audio Transcription
nodes.title: Transcription Handler
nodes.description: Processes API requests for audio-to-text transcription, utilizing appropriate models managed by the system for speech recognition tasks.

nodes.label: Run HTTP Server
nodes.title: Uvicorn Server
nodes.description: An external ASGI web server (Uvicorn) that hosts the API endpoints, handles incoming HTTP requests, and routes them to the appropriate handlers.

quantization_and_integrations.title: Quantization and Integrations
quantization_and_integrations.description: This module provides tools for optimizing model performance and integrating with external systems. It includes various quantization techniques to reduce model size and accelerate inference, as well as utilities for connecting with external libraries and services for experiment tracking, hyperparameter tuning, and efficient model serving via CLI.

nodes.label: Model Quantization
nodes.title: Model Quantization Techniques
nodes.description: Provides various techniques (e.g., 4-bit, 8-bit, FP8) to reduce model size and accelerate inference, supporting both pre-quantized models and on-the-fly quantization.

nodes.label: External Integrations
nodes.title: External Tools Integration
nodes.description: Connects Hugging Face models and workflows with external platforms for experiment tracking (Wandb, DVCLive), hyperparameter search, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT).

nodes.label: CLI Serving Tools
nodes.title: Command-Line Serving Tools
nodes.description: Offers command-line interfaces for serving Transformer models via an API, including features like continuous batching, dynamic model management, and integration with quantization.

nodes.label: Model Architectures
nodes.title: Core Model Definitions
nodes.description: The foundational module containing definitions of various deep learning models that are optimized and served by this module.

nodes.label: Pipelines & Generation
nodes.title: Generation Logic & Task Pipelines
nodes.description: Provides core text generation algorithms and high-level task-specific pipelines, which can be integrated with external tools or served via CLI.
